_ordering_rationale: Lease Income (coeur business), Same Property NOI (qualite portefeuille), % Leased (occupation), Core Operating Earnings et Nareit FFO (rentabilite REIT).

kpis.signal: Croissance recurrente du loyer, portefeuille grocery-anchored resilient
kpis.description_fr: Revenu locatif Regency Centers : base rent + recoveries de tenants + percentage rent + straight-line rent + amortissement above/below market. Grocery-anchored shopping centers suburbains US. Pilier du business REIT.
kpis.description_en: Regency Centers lease income: base rent + tenant recoveries + percentage rent + straight-line rent + above/below market amortization. US grocery-anchored suburban shopping centers. Core REIT business.
kpis._specific_to: Regency grocery-anchored shopping centers core revenue

kpis.signal: Indicateur cle REIT : croissance organique du portefeuille existant, ex-acquisitions
kpis.description_fr: Net Operating Income sur le pool de proprietes detenues sur l'ensemble des periodes comparables. Metric REIT de reference pour mesurer la performance organique hors acquisitions et dispositions.
kpis.description_en: Net Operating Income on the pool of properties owned over comparable periods. Key REIT metric for organic performance ex-acquisitions and dispositions.

kpis.signal: Recuperation post-COVID complete, niveau record d occupation
kpis.description_fr: Pourcentage de la surface louable (GLA) faisant l objet de baux signes en fin d exercice. Indicateur d occupation et de demande pour les centres commerciaux Regency.
kpis.description_en: Percentage of gross leasable area (GLA) under signed lease at year-end. Occupancy and demand indicator for Regency shopping centers.

kpis.signal: Mesure REIT non-GAAP des profits operationnels recurrents
kpis.description_fr: Mesure non-GAAP Regency : FFO ajuste de certains items non recurrents et non operationnels pour refleter la rentabilite operationnelle reelle. Source : 10-K Regency.
kpis.description_en: Regency non-GAAP measure: FFO adjusted for certain non-recurring and non-operating items to reflect true operational profitability. Source: Regency 10-K.

kpis.signal: Standard de l industrie REIT pour la generation de cash operationnel
kpis.description_fr: Funds From Operations selon la definition Nareit : resultat net + depreciation/amortissement immobilier - gains sur ventes de proprietes. Mesure de reference pour les REITs.
kpis.description_en: Funds From Operations per Nareit definition: net income + real estate D&A - gains on property sales. REIT industry-standard metric.
